description: Supports the early adoption of advanced, highly integrated digital and sustainability pilot solutions.
fundingamount: Up to 70% funding for qualifying costs including hardware, software, integration, and project management.
fundingpercentage: Up to 70% funding for qualifying costs including hardware, software, integration, and project management.
eligibilitycriteria: Registered/operating in SG; minimum 30% local equity; SME scale (turnover <S$100M or <200 workers).
supportedusecases: AI-driven predictive analytics, integrated cybersecurity networks, supply chain blockchain pilots, GenAI integration.
applicationprocess: 1. Respond to Call for Proposals (CFP). 2. Map to Industry Digital Plans (IDPs). 3. IMDA panel review.
requireddocuments: Detailed pilot proposal, hardware/software specs, vendor quotes, team track record.
restrictions: Must demonstrate how the pilot solution can be scaled eventually to benefit the broader SME ecosystem.
